items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: Yeah, he's a distant cousin of mine. That's my first cousin's son. Eddie Bo. Which first cousin is that? That's, uh, Freddie Boccage.

ctx.x: Mm-hmm. I never saw one yet. Mm-hmm. They had a nice tone?
Oh, who's Freddie playing? Freddie playing down there with, who he playing with?
The Dukes of Dixieland. Yeah. Yeah. I saw him the other night.
